title: Cloud-Native & Cloud Architecture
intro: Cloud-native interviews test whether you design for the cloud's failure model, not just deploy to it. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with the 12-factor app (the canonical cloud-native methodology), then cloud design patterns (circuit breaker, sidecar, ambassador), then deployment strategies. Comparisons and scenarios follow, then the advanced tier — cost optimization, multi-region architecture, and disaster recovery — the concerns that separate a cloud-native architect from someone who just uses managed services.
